description: Pole-mounted Huey on a 15-foot curved steel arm nose-down; bought from a surplus source at Niagara Falls NY; stripped of engine and transmission and repainted; Army service two Vietnam tours 1966-67 and 1968-70 per the Philadelphia Inquirer 29 Jul 2018; craned into place July 2018 and dedicated 13 Oct 2018; no serial published and no 2023-26 sighting obtained
